#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& is;
    vector<char> buf;
    int pos, size;

    InputReader(istream& in) : is(in), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (size == -1)
            throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            is.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            size = is.gcount();
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

int maxMatching(vector<vector<int>>& g) {
    int n = g.size();
    vector<int> match(n, -1);
    vector<int> p(n);
    int result = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (match[i] == -1) {
            int v = -1;
            vector<int> used(n, 0);
            vector<int> base(n);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) base[j] = j;
            queue<int> q;
            vector<int> p(n, -1);
            q.push(i);
            used[i] = 1;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                for (int vtx : g[u]) {
                    if (base[u] == base[vtx] || match[u] == vtx)
                        continue;
                    if (vtx == i || (match[vtx] != -1 && p[match[vtx]] != -1)) {
                        int curbase = lca(match, base, p, u, vtx);
                        vector<bool> blossom(n, false);
                        markPath(match, base, blossom, p, u, curbase, vtx);
                        markPath(match, base, blossom, p, vtx, curbase, u);
                        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                            if (blossom[base[j]]) {
                                base[j] = curbase;
                                if (!used[j]) {
                                    used[j] = 1;
                                    q.push(j);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (p[vtx] == -1) {
                        p[vtx] = u;
                        if (match[vtx] == -1) {
                            v = vtx;
                            break;
                        }
                        v = match[vtx];
                        used[v] = 1;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
                if (v != -1) break;
            }

            if (v != -1) {
                while (v != -1) {
                    int pv = p[v];
                    int ppv = match[pv];
                    match[v] = pv;
                    match[pv] = v;
                    v = ppv;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        if (match[i] != -1)
            result++;
    return result / 2;
}

int lca(const vector<int>& match, vector<int>& base, vector<bool>& used, int a, int b) {
    vector<bool> visited(match.size(), false);
    while (true) {
        a = base[a];
        visited[a] = true;
        if (match[a] == -1)
            break;
        a = base[match[a]];
    }
    while (true) {
        b = base[b];
        if (visited[b])
            return b;
        b = base[match[b]];
    }
}

void markPath(const vector<int>& match, vector<int>& base, vector<bool>& blossom, vector<int>& p, int u, int curbase, int child) {
    for (; base[u] != curbase; u = p[match[u]]) {
        blossom[base[u]] = true;
        blossom[base[match[u]]] = true;
        p[u] = child;
        child = match[u];
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    long long V = (long long)n * m;

    if (V < 100) {
        vector<vector<int>> g((int)V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < V; ++j) {
                int r1 = i / m;
                int c1 = i % m;
                int r2 = j / m;
                int c2 = j % m;
                if (abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3) {
                    g[i].push_back(j);
                }
            }
        }
        int res = maxMatching(g) * 2;
        cout << res << "\n";
    } else {
        long long res;
        if (n == 1) {
            res = (m / 6) * 6 + ((m % 6 == 4) ? 2 : 0) + ((m % 6 == 5) ? 4 : 0);
        } else {
            res = (long long)n * m;
            res -= res % 2;
        }
        cout << res << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
